label: Multi-platform writer
headline: Shuffling words and juggling thoughts across platforms.
intro: A decade in advertising and user experience design — from Sesame Street scripts and award-winning print ads to product tone and voice. Currently leading the UX Writer Hub at Telkom Indonesia.
about: Born when David Bowie and Mick Jagger’s “Dancing in the Street” topped the UK chart. Gave up drawing after only a year in kindergarten. Now thoroughly enjoying life as a writer — after splitting my time between advertising, TV scriptwriting and, occasionally, music, I took the leap to UX writing.
contactText: Message me to hear about my latest maneuver — or to find out where the best fried rice hawker in town is.
